description.en:
Number of items per page.

- Default value is 10.

description.zh:
查询作品的状态。取值范围：

- 0：未发布
- 1：已发布
- 2：已修改未发布
- 3：已下线
description.en:
The status of the work to query. Possible values:

- 0: Unpublished
- 1: Published
- 2: Modified but not published
- 3: Offline

description.zh:
第三方嵌入状态。取值范围：

- 0：暂未开通嵌入
- 1：已开通嵌入
description.en:
Third-party embedding status. Possible values:

- 0: Embedding not enabled
- 1: Embedding enabled

description.zh:
查询作品的类型，填空为查询所有类型。取值范围：

- DATAPRODUCT：数据门户
- PAGE：仪表板
- REPORT：电子表格
- dashboardOfflineQuery：自助取数
description.en:
The type of work to query. Leave blank to query all types. Possible values:

- DATAPRODUCT: Data Portal
- PAGE: Dashboard
- REPORT: Spreadsheet
- dashboardOfflineQuery: Self-service Data Retrieval
